message: So, the other day I decided to make my famous chili. You know, the one that makes the whole neighborhood jealous? Well, as I was stirring the pot, I got a little too caught up in my own culinary genius and forgot to check the smoke alarm. Let's just say, the smoke detector had a better performance than I did that night! It reminded me that even in the kitchen, it’s super important to have a plan — not just for the meal, but for what to do if things get a little too heated. Ever had a cooking adventure turn into a comedy show?
